result.summary: Found 1 issue: a missing icon inside the top-right header action button.

issues.description: The circular action button in the top-right corner of the header displays a red notification badge dot, but the main icon inside the button (such as a notification bell or shopping bag) fails to render, leaving an empty gray circle.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the SVG or icon asset for the top-right header button is properly loaded and visible with sufficient contrast against the light gray circular background.
